notes: MLCommons ml_spoken_words (Multilingual Spoken Words Corpus) — 1-second real keyword-clip recordings, HF parquet-convert mirror (refs/convert/parquet, config 'en_wav', split 'partial-test' — the smallest available partial split; the base repo ships a loading script and is not viewer/streamable, so the auto-converted parquet mirror is the only fetchable form). Registered as a hard-negative source for the wake_word league: real short keyword clips in this language that MUST NOT trigger any wake-word engine, a harder false-accept test than synthetic or ambient-noise negatives. role=unrestricted (openly-available supplementary corpus, not itself a positive/negative eval set). Wired into the wake_word league via negatives_dataset_ids on its matching-language fighter dataset(s): resolved through the registry loader and streamed via runner.audio_io.stream_audio_dataset (the HF-parquet path used by STT/VAD positives) rather than the file-listing negatives_sources/negatives_hf mechanism, which only works for audiofolder-shaped corpora and cannot consume this corpus's parquet row-group audio.
